objective: Publish a code-accurate cruush safety article on the existing static blog.
userOutcome: Visitors can read the safety article from the cruush blog, including current server-side encryption, privacy-preserving location discovery, Ghost Mode, mutual cruush protections, and the positive E2EE roadmap.
successCriteria: The existing /blog page links to the new safety article.
The article accurately distinguishes live server-side encryption and privacy controls from planned E2EE.
The article does not claim member-facing NSFW photo permission settings that are not currently reachable.
The new article and blog index render at mobile and desktop widths with no layout regressions.
The frontend and server builds, security checks, casing checks, and diff checks pass.
The pushed commit is deployed and the live blog route serves the new article.
mustPreserve: The existing static blog architecture, pages.css styling, navigation, privacy restrictions, and service-worker behavior.
nonGoals: No E2EE implementation or backend rollout.
No NSFW photo permission UI or settings change.
No database migration, account-status change, map change, or unrelated product UI change.
No internal secrets, provider details, key names, or task evidence in public copy.

assumptions.statement: The existing static blog on cruush.app is the publication target, and the new article uses the current public safety model plus a clearly future E2EE roadmap.
assumptions.impact: Only public static blog files and their indexing headers are changed.

nextVisibleMilestone: The article is visible at /blog/safety-on-cruush.html in the live cruush site.
stopConditions: Stop if the server build fails.

job: Publish the requested safety article from a clean branch and isolated worktree.
proofTarget: Rendered /blog and /blog/safety-on-cruush.html at 375 px and desktop, focused checks, both builds, remote SHA, and live article content.
requiredEvidence: Rendered blog index and article screenshots at mobile and desktop widths.
Both containers on the pushed SHA and the live article route.
